description: Use this when the user has a photo, PDF drawing, STEP, STL, DXF, SVG or 3MF file on their device and you need it in a kernelCAD tool (trace_from_image, drawing_to_cad, mesh_to_features, inspect of:"step", or lib.fromSTEP / fromSTL / fromDXF / fromSVG / referenceImage in a script). Do not ask the user to paste the file as text or base64, and do not type coordinates from an image by hand. Returns a one-time `uploadUrl` (valid 30 minutes) and an `asset` reference. Give the user the link; after they say the upload is done, pass the `asset` value ("asset:<id>") as the file argument, for example trace_from_image({ imageUrl: "asset:<id>" }) or lib.fromSTEP("asset:<id>"). If the file is already at a public https:// URL, pass that URL instead.

purpose.description: Optional short note shown on the upload page, e.g. "the photo of the worn bracket".

name: request_upload
title: Request File Upload
